row.body: A first-aid kit sits open beside a split seed sack. Yellow dust covers the gauze; black road tape is stuck to the sack.
row.title: Seed dust under the bandages

sidecar.gloss: Field residue and response material share one everyday bundle.
sidecar.rival_reading: Field workers or an emergency crew could have bundled these supplies; dust and road tape leave the order of events unresolved.

row.body: The battery is new; the radio has been wrapped in a shirt to muffle it. A narrow strip of tape fixes the dial at the channel used before the order to leave.
row.title: A channel behind the lockers

sidecar.gloss: A scene-specific count or record was controlled while people were still present.
sidecar.rival_reading: The same trace could follow an investigation of contaminated farm goods or an ordinary emergency response.
